text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-cha~n. The big day is finally here.
Are you ready~?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Creek, Inari, thank you.
Having you two help out has been a huge
lifesaver."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't go actin' like strangers on me now.
We're the bunch they called the 'Eternal
Big Three,' ain't we?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. After Tama-chan, it's our turn. I'll
never forget
racing neck and neck with Oguri-chan in
the Tenno Sho (Autumn). And—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
After that was the Arima Kinen, where I
took the crown!
The taste of victory snatched right away
from Oguri was something truly special.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Tama-chan isn't your only kindred spirit.
We are too—"
Hooold on a sec!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I hope you haven't forgotten about
us—Yaeno and me, who competed right
alongside you in the mile division!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
While Oguri-san was running medium
distances—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Defeating Bamboo-san at the Mile
Championship, held between
the Tenno Sho (Autumn) and the Japan Cup.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even at the Yasuda Kinen the following
year, they repelled my all-out strike
and claimed a magnificent victory.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, that's right. Two consecutive
Mile GⅠ wins...
Just how deep are your depths, you
bastard?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Looking back like this, Oguri...
You're practically... a migratory bird of
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A migratory bird... of dreams?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's true~. There probably aren't many
Umamusume who've run such a jam-packed
schedule and won across so many different
distances.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
At various distances...
Yeah... you're right...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What's the matter, Oguri? Sulkin' around
right before the main event.
City said she's ready to roll."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Tama... I've always fought with
everything I had in the race right in
front of me.
And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Did I take too much liberty with that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've entered all sorts of races purely out
of a desire to run,
but I can't help feeling I may have caused
quite a ruckus in the process...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it have been better for
everyone's... for the Twinkle Series' sake
if we had chosen our races more
thoughtfully?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"So it's for the Twinkle Series... I see.
That's what was bothering ya, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's see how folks feel about
what you've done.
Let's take a look around the venue.
...Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —!? This is...!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Take a look at these lanterns! Written on
them
are words of gratitude to you from each
and every person."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the fans. Umamusume,
Trainers, staff...
All sorts of people sent in messages.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Not just the fans, but everyone else
too...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-senpai has always been... someone I
looked up to. I was only
ever watching from behind while the two of
you fought for the lead.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I want to be involved somehow. I
want to preserve that brilliance.
That's why I asked to participate in this
event."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Going too far with doing things freely?
As if that's a thing.
You, and everyone who ran alongside you—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"She changed the Twinkle Series!
Just take a look at the racetracks today."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, the racetrack was so
cutthroat,
and now the whole place is chanting! The
entire crowd is roaring!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"She's gained new fans too. Nowadays, top
Umamusume are bona fide superstars in high
demand across all media."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you.
Just take a look at each and every one of
these messages.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Can you still say you ruined the race
after reading this?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Tama... Tama... Ah... My... running...
All those days I spent running... ever
since Kasamatsu..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So it was leading... all the way to
this...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-senpai, Tamamo-senpai, it's almost
time. We're going to fill the sky
with these lanterns, so please... sing in
the middle of them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san, thank you so much.
For teaching all of us what true courage
is.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Oguri-chan.
For being the idol Umamusume everyone
loves so dearly.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Oguri.
For running in the same era as me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone... thank you all as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us go. Wherever our hearts may
lead, wherever our dreams take us.
Just as we always have, and always will—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I will run. Carrying all of everyone's
expectations—
toward the future of the Twinkle Series
that stretches far ahead.
